page_title: AI Virtual Staging & Real Estate Marketing | IACrea

summary.name: IACrea
summary.one_liner: IACrea is an AI marketing tool for real estate agents that offers virtual staging, photo editing, listing videos, 2D floor plans and social media/Meta ad publishing from one platform.
use_cases: Virtual staging of empty listing rooms
Enhancing listing photos with HDR and sky replacement
Turning listing photos into short videos
Creating 2D floor plans from an iPhone scan
Running Facebook and Instagram ad campaigns for listings
summary.what_it_does: IACrea takes photos taken with its mobile app or uploaded from elsewhere and applies AI editing, including virtual staging, furnishing, decluttering, color changes, object removal, sky replacement, HDR effects and virtual renovation. It can turn photos into animated videos with pans and zooms, and add text, music, transitions, voiceovers and subtitles. Users can create 2D floor plans by scanning homes with the iPhone app, schedule and auto-publish posts across multiple social networks, and launch one-click Meta campaigns on Facebook, Instagram and Threads. Usage is metered through credits (for example 0.1 credit per photo edit and 1 credit per video animation), and plans are Solo and Agency.
notable: Credit-based AI pricing: 0.1 credit per photo edit, 1 credit per video animation, 60 credits per Meta campaign
2D floor plans created by scanning homes with the iPhone app (iPhone Pro only, premium add-on)
Solo plan at $27.24/month excl. tax and Agency plan at $70.81/month excl. tax, no contract
Credits roll over up to 3x monthly credits on plans
caveats: Paid subscription; Solo starts at $27.24/month excl. tax and Agency at $70.81/month excl. tax
2D floor plans require an iPhone Pro and are a premium add-on
Meta campaigns need at least 60 credits each
Free trial mentioned in page meta description, no credit card required
